Task.title: Task
Task.description: A user task, habit, inbox item, or archived item synchronized across devices.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the task owner.

columnId.description: Current column or bucket where the task lives.

originalColumnId.description: Origin column preserved when a task is archived so it can be restored accurately.

checked.description: Whether the task is currently marked complete.

notes.description: Optional detailed notes for the task.

subtasks.description: Bounded list (max 30) of subtask objects { id, content, checked }.

streak.description: Consecutive completion streak count for habits.

lastCompletedDate.description: Last calendar date (yyyy-MM-dd) when a habit was completed.

habitHistory.description: Bounded list (max 60) of yyyy-MM-dd completion date strings for habit analytics.

completedAt.description: ISO timestamp when task was completed.

archivedAt.description: ISO timestamp when task was archived.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last modification.

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: Per-user workspace preferences including custom column titles and rollover tracking.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

lastRolloverDate.description: Last yyyy-MM-dd date on which daily archive and habit reset ran.

columnTitles.description: Optional map of custom display names for board columns.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last preference update.

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: Private tasks, habits, inbox items, and archived records owned by userId.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: Private workspace preferences (preferences, sync_probe) owned by userId.
